name: Aoi
source:
A cheerful, self-proclaimed average third year junior high school student. He's always loved his grandfather and has been able to see spirits since he was little.

[Translated from official profile]

[spoiler]His full name is Aoi Akane / 青井 アカネ.[/spoiler]
